mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% (y/y), or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 950,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 950.0 (thousands of units) for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle labor market regimes (PAYEMS growth > 200k per month for 3 months), strong job creation signals overheating and imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k per month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k for 3 months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 4.0% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 2.0%, it indicates a lagged policy response that fails to curb inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 4.0% (y/y) and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
